config.install_note: Available on npm. Optional features need their own peer (see the scopes below).
config.scope_desc: There is one npm package (`wimui`). Think in scopes: start with Core; pull optional subpaths only when you need them. This is not a multi-package monorepo. Optional components stay off the root barrel so apps that never use charts/AI/RHF do not pull those peers into resolve or mental load.
config.scope_data_peers: Markdown / ScheduleView / graphs — see peer table in README
config.scope_note: Do not `import { BarChart } from "wimui"` — use `wimui/charts` (and install `recharts`). Same for `wimui/ai`, peer parts of `wimui/data-display`, and `wimui/rhf`. Canonical map: `src/data/peer-imports.json`.
config.css_desc: Import CSS once at the app entry. `styles.css` (tokens + components) is required; reset is optional.
config.css_tokens_role: Design tokens (`:root` `--wim-*`, including dark + density maps) — now shipped inside `styles.css`
config.css_styles_role: Design tokens (`:root` `--wim-*`, including dark + density) plus all component styles
config.css_reset_role: Opinionated reset / base element styles — omit if it fights your app CSS
config.css_umd_note: UMD builds (`wimui.umd.js` + `wimui.umd.css`) bundle styles (tokens + components) and reset in one file.
config.theme_desc: Prefer `WimProvider` (`theme` / `density` / `locale`). It writes `data-theme` on `<html>`. Use `system` (default) to follow OS `prefers-color-scheme`. Do not rename the attribute.
config.brand_desc: Override public role tokens after `wimui/styles.css`. Start with `primary`, `primary-rgb`, and `text-on-primary`. Derived tokens (`primary-hover`, `primary-muted`, …) usually follow automatically. Do not override `--wim-comp-*` or palette raw colors.
config.brand_note: `primary-rgb` must be comma-separated channels (not `rgb(...)`). Optional: override `primary-fill` for dark fill surfaces. Full list: Token → Colors / `DESIGN.md`.
config.density_desc: Set via `WimProvider` `density`, `setWimDensity`, or the attribute on `<html>` (or any ancestor). Values: `comfortable` (default) | `compact`. See Token → Density.
config.quality_lint_staged_desc: Run linters on git staged files
